author: Xuph
body:
Me, {tag=cad8013ab98a40679f0981b0734e0085} and {tag=54964b606ce749229a4c2b981d8c2ed7} are retiring

ryan: I've thought to myself and I don't want to be apart of the mapdev team I find that it's not organised and I don't even know what I need to do as I was was just promoted to mapdev and told nothing. I find that the maps that I put a lot of effort into with my friends don't get played or put into rotations. 

I know that I've been apart of the mapdev team for a short time. I'm not quitting from avicus but I won't really be playing here much unless it's for scrims/tournaments, I will be active on ts. 

Bye

-Ryan

eric: Just like ryan, i agree with all his points
The mapdev team is unorganised and led by people who hold too many responsibilities
It's came to the point where i have no motivation to build for this network anymore
All the maps ive put the most effort in dont get used ever
I'd rather focus on building for badlion
It's been a nice run, bye folks

I build for so many networks at this point including Badlion Valux Vexir Equinox and others, and they seem to appreciate your work unlike this network.

As much as i hate this at this point im thankful for this network for so many memories and for letting me start my minecraft pvp career ! XD

spook:
I don't believe that the work I have been doing is being implemented properly into avicus and/or is not really appreciated. This has lead me to become less active and I'm not really contributing to the builder team anymore.

Thanks for the opportunity


We are not stopping to play, we are just retiring. We will be here mostly for scrims or just fucking around
We all seem to step down from the same reason. I personally lost hope in this network but i hope this will give you the sign that this network is fucked and something needs to be done.


Bye
